summary: 6 backend tests passed, 5 browser checks passed. Backup-ke-Flashdisk feature fully functional: fake-usb drive detection, one-click backup+copy, per-row copy, auto-copy toggle persistence, security (400/404/403), and regression of existing backup/download/delete flows.

checks.criterion: Admin sees flashdisk panel on Backup page (/backup)
checks.name: backup-flashdisk-panel-visible
checks.evidence: usb-panel visible, usb-status text contains 'fake-usb' and 'WARUNG-BACKUP'; clicking usb-refresh-button triggered GET /api/v1/backups/usb -> 200, panel still shows fake-usb after refetch.

checks.criterion: Admin sees flashdisk panel on Backup page (/backup) - API
checks.name: test_usb_status_shows_fake_usb_drive
checks.evidence: GET /api/v1/backups/usb -> 200, drives contains label 'fake-usb' with free_bytes>0, auto_copy field present.

checks.name: backup-one-click-to-flashdisk
checks.evidence: Clicked usb-backup-now-button -> POST /api/v1/backups 200; toast text contains 'fake-usb' and 'Aman untuk dicabut'; row backup-usb-copied-{id} visible with 'fake-usb' label.

checks.criterion: One-click 'Backup ke Flashdisk' - file exists on disk
checks.name: manual verification
checks.evidence: ls /tmp/fake-usb/WARUNG-BACKUP/ shows newly created wbc-backup-20260926-014057-manual.json.gz matching the created backup.

checks.criterion: Copy an existing backup row to flashdisk via row USB icon
checks.name: backup-row-copy-to-flashdisk
checks.evidence: Created backup via backup-now-button (no usb label), then clicked backup-usb-{id} icon -> POST /api/v1/backups/{id}/copy-to-usb 200 {label:'fake-usb', dest contains WARUNG-BACKUP, size>0}; row then shows usb-copied label.

checks.criterion: Copy an existing backup row to flashdisk via row USB icon - API
checks.name: test_backup_now_then_copy_to_usb
checks.evidence: POST /api/v1/backups -> 200; POST /api/v1/backups/{id}/copy-to-usb {path:/tmp/fake-usb} -> 200 {label:fake-usb, dest:.../WARUNG-BACKUP/..., size matches}; GET /api/v1/backups shows usb_copied_to contains fake-usb.

checks.name: backup-auto-copy-toggle-persists
checks.evidence: usb-auto-checkbox toggled true -> PUT /api/v1/backups/usb/auto 200 {auto_copy:true}; page reload confirms aria-checked=true persisted; toggled back to false -> PUT 200 {auto_copy:false}, confirmed unchecked; final state left unchecked.

checks.name: test_auto_copy_toggle_persists_then_reset
checks.evidence: PUT /api/v1/backups/usb/auto {auto_copy:true} -> 200; re-GET /api/v1/backups/usb confirms auto_copy:true; PUT false -> 200; re-GET confirms false. State restored to original value.

checks.name: test_copy_to_usb_rejects_non_detected_path / test_copy_to_usb_unknown_backup_id_404 / test_kasir_forbidden_on_usb_status
checks.evidence: POST /api/v1/backups/{id}/copy-to-usb {path:/etc} -> 400 'Flashdisk tidak ditemukan'; POST .../tscheck-unknown-id-xyz/copy-to-usb -> 404 'Backup tidak ditemukan'; kasir GET /api/v1/backups/usb -> 403.

checks.name: backup-regression-basic-flow
checks.evidence: backup-now-button -> POST /api/v1/backups 200, row appears; download link href = /api/v1/backups/{id}/download; delete icon -> DELETE /api/v1/backups/{id} 200, row removed. Restore not exercised per instructions.
